'''Amada Lakhasa''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]]. Although he left [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] with little more than than a beat-up [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and a few [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], he became the head of one of the most long-running scout organizations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Lakhasa Caravan]].<ref name="TUR" />
